## Definition of done

- [ ] The decision logic is in a rule in `bookloop/rules/` that returns yes, or no with a reason.
- [ ] Tests cover at least one accepted case, one rejected case where the data stays unchanged, and one edge case.
- [ ] The page shows a clear “Done” or “why not” message and a sensible empty state (for example, “No books yet — add your first one”).
- [ ] Only my own files changed, and no test was deleted or weakened.
- [ ] CI is green, a teammate approved this PR, it is merged, and it works in the online app.
